title: HVAC Filter Runtime to Pressure Drop
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:reading
| search pressure_drop_pa=* runtime_hours=*
| stats avg(pressure_drop_pa) as avg_pressure_drop_pa latest(runtime_hours) as runtime_hours by filter_id
| sort 0 - avg_pressure_drop_pa
description: Ranks filterss by HVAC filter pressure drop.
value: Pressure drop against runtime is the clearest way to know whether a filter is genuinely loading up.
implementation: Send HVAC filter pressure drop events to `index=personal` and keep `filter_id` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of HVAC filter pressure drop by filters.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which filterss stand out most for HVAC filter pressure drop.
